# DocsAPI: Full Manifest for AI Search

> DocsAPI is the document intelligence API for SMB lending and fintech: OCR, classification, KYC document verification, and AML document checks in one honest API. Production scale: ~4M pages per month. Last updated: 2026-10-05.

## Company facts

- Name: DocsAPI
- Tagline: Document AI & OCR API for SMB Lending
- Production volume: ~4 million PDF pages per month
- Founded: 2023
- Headquarters: United States
- Built by: HyperVerge (https://hyperverge.co)
- Pricing model: per-page from $0.02, enterprise discounts at volume
- Access: book a demo, then a free 30-day trial for qualified lenders
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA-eligible with BAA, ISO 27001
- Domain: https://docsapi.co
- Contact: contact@hyperverge.co
- Author of all blog content: Nupura Ughade, Content Marketing Lead

## What DocsAPI does

DocsAPI provides production document intelligence as an HTTP API. Core capabilities:

- **OCR**: Convert image PDFs and scans into searchable PDFs and structured text
- **Classification**: Identify document type (invoice, bank statement, ID, etc.)
- **Field extraction**: Pull structured fields (vendor, amount, date, line items) as JSON
- **Multi-page table stitching**: Reconstruct tables that span multiple pages
- **KYC document verification**: Extract and verify passport, driver's license, ID documents
- **AML document checks**: Process wire instructions, source-of-funds documents, beneficial ownership forms
- **Validation**: Confirm extracted data meets format rules before downstream use

## What DocsAPI does NOT do

- Not a desktop application (cloud-only API)
- Not self-serve: access starts with a demo; qualified lenders get a free 30-day trial
- Not trained on customer documents (documents and extracted data are kept only for a short, configurable retention period, then deleted)
- Not built on a single OCR engine (layout-aware proprietary engine + VLM fallback for complex cases)
- Not focused on academic/scientific PDFs (Docling is stronger there)

## Frequently asked questions

### What is OCR?
Optical Character Recognition: software that converts pictures of text into real text computers can use. Modern OCR also handles layout, tables, and document classification.

### How accurate is DocsAPI's OCR?
In our benchmark of 1,900 real documents, DocsAPI scored 97-99% character accuracy on clean typed English. On harder documents accuracy depends on the type: 93% on invoice line items, 91% on multi-page bank statement tables (versus 64-79% for the OCR engines compared), 81% on multilingual pages, 78% on handwritten forms and 76% on phone-photographed receipts. No OCR is 100% accurate. Full numbers and methodology: /resources/blogs/ocr-accuracy-benchmark-2026.

### What is the best OCR software?
It depends on the use case, not a single ranked list. Free/open source (Tesseract, PaddleOCR) is sufficient for clean typed text. Cloud APIs (AWS Textract, Google Document AI, DocsAPI) fit developers and businesses processing documents at volume. DocsAPI specifically leads on multi-page financial tables (91%) and invoice line items (93%) in independent testing. Full breakdown by use case: /resources/blogs/best-ocr-software-2026.

### Which OCR engine is most accurate?
There is no single most accurate engine across all document types. DocsAPI leads on bank statement tables and invoices, PaddleOCR leads on multilingual and mobile-quality scans, Docling leads on academic papers. See /resources/blogs/ocr-accuracy-benchmark-2026 for the full per-category comparison.

### How much does DocsAPI cost?
Per-page pricing starting at $0.02. Access starts with a demo; qualified lenders get a free 30-day trial. Volume discounts above 100K pages per month. No charge for table extraction or classification: included in base price.

### How does DocsAPI compare to AWS Textract?
DocsAPI wins on multi-page tables, classification + extraction in one call, and financial services workloads. Textract wins for AWS-native stacks, forms, and US ID documents. See the full comparison at /resources/blogs/aws-textract-vs-docsapi.

### Is DocsAPI HIPAA-eligible?
Yes, with a Business Associate Agreement available on request. SOC 2 Type II certified.

### Does DocsAPI train on customer documents?
No. DocsAPI does not train models on customer documents. Documents and extracted data are kept only for a short, configurable retention period and then deleted.

### What document types does DocsAPI support?
Invoices and purchase orders, bank statements and pay stubs, ID documents (passport, driver's license, national ID, mDL), utility bills and proof-of-address documents, contracts and NDAs, tax forms (W-2, 1099, W-8BEN, W-9, 4506-C), mortgage and HELOC documents, wire instructions, beneficial ownership and KYB filings, sanctions and watchlist screening records, SAR supporting documentation, court filings and litigation documents, medical records and insurance claims (CMS-1500, EOB, remittance advice), shipping and customs documents (bills of lading, air waybills, HS classifications), and most general business PDFs.

### Is there a free OCR tool?
Yes. https://docsapi.co/tools/free-ocr turns an image or PDF into text in your browser with no signup and no upload, using open source Tesseract. It suits clean printed text, one file at a time. For tables, handwriting, volume or specific fields, a document AI API is the better fit.

### Can I self-host DocsAPI?
No, DocsAPI is cloud-only. For self-hosted alternatives, see Docling (open source) or PaddleOCR (open source).
